capabilities.description: Delegate one local goal to a task runtime that admits supported work under its deployment profile.

attributes.name: task-profile
attributes.description: Deployment profile of the receiving local task runtime.

capabilities.description: Capture an immutable reported origin from a readonly local observation; grants no motion or localization verification.
Independent fresh post-completion Robonix aggregate posture report verification. This observes reported state and grants no action, retry or physical-stop authority.

operations.description: Submit the complete local outcome and all local action limits to the already selected local task runtime, then track its attributed result. RG owns participant selection, authorization, approval and dispatch. The receiver executes this robot's goal; it must not be asked to inspect RG inventory, prove cluster uniqueness, match a local robot name to an RG alias, or recursively call this RG operation. Preserve participant scope in Mission/Role requirements; never invent a physical binding or waive unresolved selection.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Exact deployed task profile admitted by the receiving runtime.

parameters.name: expected_posture
parameters.description: Explicit reported-state target standing or down for opted-in posture tasks. Such tasks must declare verifier-evidence, observation.posture.verify-reported@v1, exact predicate fresh post-completion Robonix aggregate reports standing (or down), and 5000 ms policy bound before approval/admission. This metadata never adds local action authority.

operations.description: Freeze one original Task observation as origin Memory. Explicit global scope offers this one record to the Node publisher. It does not load maps or call Pilot.

parameters.name: memory_id
parameters.description: A new immutable origin identity; repetitions cannot overwrite it.

parameters.name: expected_map_id
parameters.description: Exact expected local Mapping map label, not a verified shared frame or map revision.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Explicit global for shared experiment publication, or local for nonpublished local retention.
